clips.title: The story
paras: Lordamere Lake lies between Tirisfal Glades, Silverpine Forest, and the Alterac Mountains, its waters now shadowed by the undead. Once the northern heart of human life, its cold waters and islands are haunted by Scourge necromancers and feral murlocs.

Lordamere Lake once joined the centers of human power in the north. The Capital City of Lordaeron guarded its northern shores, Dalaran rose near the southern reach, and Alterac lined the eastern edge beneath its mountains. Merchant vessels and fishing boats crossed the broad lake without fear. After the devastation of the Third War, the lake became a natural barrier between the Forsaken-held lands of Tirisfal and Silverpine and the treacherous heights of Alterac.
